The clue presents a straightforward age calculation pattern. If a child born in 1995 turns 15 in 2010 (1995 + 15), applying the same addition to a birth year of 5 B.C. yields 10 A.D. (5 + 15 = 20, crossing into the A.D. era). In trivia and historical dating puzzles of this type, the standard accepted answer ignores the absence of a year 0 and simply adds the years across the epoch boundary.

<answer>10 AD</answer>
